profile_text.body:
C3.ai, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Redwood City, California, and trades under the ticker AI. Its SEC central index key is 0001577526. The website associated with the company in the available material is airliquide.com, whose text describes a world leader in gases, technologies and services for industry and healthcare. That text states the business serves 4.3 million customers and patients across 59 countries with approximately 65,000 employees, and it announces a research chair on artificial intelligence for chemistry and through chemistry created with the École normale supérieure and its Foundation.

The material does not list any AI products for C3.ai, Inc., and no MCP servers are recorded. No lawsuits are recorded either, though the company is recorded as having exposure in California, with a count of 281.

The two sets of facts do not line up: the company name and filing details point to C3.ai, Inc., while the website text describes Air Liquide. Nothing in the available material explains the mismatch, so the profile cannot go beyond what each source states on its own.
